name: Banana Pudding
desc: Layers of vanilla wafers, sliced bananas and a no-cook vanilla pudding lightened with whipped topping.

source.title: The Best Banana Pudding
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts, including the 14 bananas, 12 oz whipped topping and 1 tbsp vanilla, and the same whisk, fold and layer method.

ingredients.raw: 1 (5 oz) package instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (12 oz) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
14 small ripe bananas (about 7 large), sliced 1/4 inch thick

steps: Whisk the milk and pudding mix in a large bowl for 2 minutes, until thickened. Whisk in the condensed milk until smooth.
Stir in the vanilla, then gently fold in the whipped topping.
Slice the bananas right before assembling so they do not brown. Set aside a few wafers for the top.
In a large glass serving bowl or a 9x13-inch dish, layer wafers, then banana slices, then pudding. Repeat the layers, ending with pudding.
Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. Crush the reserved wafers over the top right before serving.
tips: Serve it the day it is made: after about 8 hours in the fridge the bananas start to brown.

references.title: The Best Banana Pudding
references.usedFor: confirmed 14 bananas and all amounts, slicing bananas at assembly, reserving wafers for the top, yield
